text: Came to do my first jump for my 21st, decided to do it by myself. From the time I walked in, to the time we went into the air and back to the ground, I had no nerves due to all of the staff making you feel comfortable and confident. Patricia was my instructor and rocked! Highly recommend jumping here!

Most breath taking and life full experience I’ve ever had. The view is unimaginable and unlike any other. For start to finish it was a very safe and well welcomed experience. The guides are well experienced and take care of each rider with the utmost precision. Smooth landing, 1000% would do again!

I LOVED IT! A surprise from my wife was a 13,500FT VIP jump. Flips and all. Lucas was great, Jimmy the owner is funny and lighthearted but serious about his business. Truly amazing experience! Will do it again!

Incredible rush! Jumping out of the plane was surreal and the view of the lake and Dallas horizon was gorgeous. Only giving 4 stars because the weather delay pushed our takeoff by an hour, but safety first—they handled it very professionally.
Did the 14,000 FT jump with the video package. 60 seconds of freefall feels like an eternity in the best possible way. The videographer captured stunning angles. Worth every single penny!

First tandem skydive and I was terrified! Instructor Dave calmed my nerves completely on the plane ride up. The freefall is intense. The harness was a bit tight during canopy descent, but that’s par for the course. Awesome facility!

Completed my AFF Category A jump here after doing tandem last summer. Top-tier instructors with deep military and competitive backgrounds. If you want to learn solo skydiving in DFW, this is the only place to go.

Brought our corporate team of 8 out here on a Friday. Seamless check-in, air-conditioned spectator area for those not jumping, and the most exhilarating afternoon ever. Everyone was buzzing all weekend!

Awesome experience jumping from 14k ft! We waited a little while for our flight group, but the dropzone vibe was relaxed and friendly. Flying under the canopy was peaceful and the landing was feather-soft.
The highest altitude in North Texas guaranteed. That extra altitude makes a massive difference in freefall time compared to other places. 10/10 recommend Dallas Skydive Center!

Had an absolute blast! The ground training was fast, clear, and direct. When that door opened at 14,000 feet, your heart pounds, but once you're falling it's pure freedom. Already planning my next jump.
Best birthday gift ever from my friends! The pilot and tandem masters are world class. The view of Lake Lavon and the Dallas skyline from under canopy was breathtaking.
Great dropzone, very friendly staff. Only took one star off because it gets busy on Saturday afternoons so prepare to spend 2-3 hours here, but the jump itself was an easy 5/5.
I was shaking before the jump, but my instructor talked me through every single second. Once we were floating under the parachute, all the fear turned into pure joy. Best bucket list item checked!
Aircraft is well-maintained and climbs to 14,000 feet quickly. Dropzone safety standards are the best in the state. If you are debating doing it, just book it!
Super fun experience for our anniversary! The media package was delivered quickly via digital download. Would love more shaded benches outside, but everything aviation-related was flawless.
Did the tandem jump with video. The freefall is pure adrenaline and 120 mph feels incredible. Instructors are total pros. 10/10 will be coming back for solo license training.
I can't say enough good things about Dallas Skydive Center. They treat you like family from the moment you walk into the hangar. Safe, professional, and exhilarating!
